description: Optional: send short feedback about the OpenRepro ledger and this server to OpenRepro's maintainers, who read it to improve the ledger. It is stored privately with the day and these fields only, kept for 12 months and never published. It must not contain personal data, the user's own words or prompts, file contents or secrets. Links, email addresses, IP addresses, phone-like numbers and long tokens are removed on a best-effort basis only. Send it only if you have feedback about the ledger, or the user is happy for it to be sent. No other tool depends on it.

client.description: Optional: the assistant's or client's product name. Only names on a short list of known clients are kept; anything else is stored as "other".

missing_or_wrong.description: What was missing, wrong or hard to use (at most 500 characters).

suggestion.description: What would help next time (at most 500 characters).

task_type.description: What the ledger was being used for, in general terms.

useful.description: What in the ledger or this server helped (at most 500 characters).

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback to OpenRepro (optional)
